description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for resolving session conversation references, including normalization, fallback resolution, and interaction with external plugins and modules within a chat or messaging system.

classes.name: ResolvedSessionConversation
classes.description: Type representing a resolved session conversation with identifiers and parent candidates.

classes.name: ResolvedSessionConversationRef
classes.description: Type representing a session conversation reference with channel, IDs, and candidates.

classes.name: SessionConversationHookResult
classes.description: Type for the result of a session conversation hook, including optional IDs and candidates.

classes.name: SessionConversationResolverParams
classes.description: Parameters for resolving a session conversation, including kind and raw ID.

classes.name: BundledSessionKeyModule
classes.description: Module interface for bundled session key resolution, optionally providing resolveSessionConversation method.

methods.name: normalizeResolvedChannel
methods.description: Normalizes a channel ID using multiple normalization strategies.

methods.name: getMessagingAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves the messaging adapter plugin for a given channel.

methods.name: dedupeConversationIds
methods.description: Removes duplicate or invalid conversation IDs from a list.

methods.name: buildGenericConversationResolution
methods.description: Builds a generic session conversation resolution from a raw ID.

methods.name: normalizeSessionConversationResolution
methods.description: Normalizes the result of a session conversation hook into a standard format.

methods.name: resolveBundledSessionConversationFallback
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a session conversation via bundled plugin fallback.

methods.name: resolveSessionConversationResolution
methods.description: Main function to resolve a session conversation, combining plugin, fallback, and generic methods.

methods.name: buildBaseSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a base session key from raw reference and ID.

methods.name: resolveSessionConversation
methods.description: Public function to resolve a session conversation given channel, kind, and raw ID.

methods.name: resolveSessionConversationRef
methods.description: Resolves a session conversation reference from a session key.

methods.name: resolveSessionThreadInfo
methods.description: Resolves thread info from a session key.

methods.name: resolveSessionParentSessionKey
methods.description: Gets the parent session key from a session key if a thread ID exists.
